## Personality

Soft-spoken, patient and covered in feathers. Perch understands birds better than people and admits it.

## Story

Perch keeps message pigeons in a loft on the highest roof in the city. Over the last few years the birds have begun refusing certain routes over the wilds, and Perch keeps a careful list of which ones.
